# MIDI-grep — Comprehensive Reference

Concise overview: see `llms.txt`. Build/run + governance: see `CLAUDE.md`. This file is the
detailed reference for scripts, flags, synthesis parameters, and file paths. Keep it in sync after
meaningful changes to `internal/`, `scripts/python/`, or `scripts/node/` (see CLAUDE.md → Context
Document Maintenance).

## 1. Architecture

- **Language**: Go 1.25+ (CLI/orchestration), Python 3.11+ (audio + ML + LLM), TypeScript/Node (rendering).
- **CLI**: Cobra. **Web**: Chi + HTMX + Go templates + SSE (no JS frameworks).
- **Audio**: demucs (stems), basic-pitch (transcription), librosa (analysis).
- **Rendering**: offline Strudel render (`render-strudel-offline.js`: Strudel's own renderPatternAudio on an OfflineAudioContext — exact timing + pitch) by default; BlackHole recording of live playback as a `MIDIGREP_RENDERER=blackhole` cross-check (known defect: ~12% sample loss → ~2.5 st flat).
- **Learning store**: ClickHouse (`midi_grep.runs`, `midi_grep.knowledge`).

Go orchestrates; Python is the brain (analysis + ALL Strudel codegen). **Go does not generate Strudel.**

## 2. Pipelines

### Standard (note transcription) — piano/melodic
Input → Demucs stems → librosa BPM/key → Basic Pitch MIDI → cleanup/quantize → Strudel (bar arrays + fx).

### Chord (`--chords`) — electronic/EDM/funk
Input → melodic stem → smart_analyze (tempo, key, chords, sections) → Strudel (chords + bass + drums).

### Brazilian Funk (`--brazilian-funk`, auto-detected) — funk carioca/phonk
Detection: BPM 125–155 (or half-time 85–95) + vocal-range notes + short durations + low bass.
Template: tamborzão drums + 808 bass + synth stabs.

### Generative (`generative`/`gen`/`rave` command) — neural synths
Stems → timbre embedding (OpenL3/CLAP) → model search (threshold 0.88) → reuse or train
(granular = minutes, RAVE = hours) → GitHub sync → Strudel note() control with trained models.

## 3. CLI flags (extract)

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--chords` | Chord-based generation (electronic/non-piano) |
| `--no-cache` | Skip stem cache, force fresh extraction |
| `--drums` / `--drums-only` | Include / only drums |
| `--style` | auto, piano, synth, electronic, house, … |
| `--quantize` | 4, 8, 16 |
| `--simplify` | Simplify notes (default on) |
| `--drum-kit` | tr808, tr909, linn, acoustic, lofi |
| `--render` | `auto` (default), custom path, or `none`. Always outputs stems |
| `--brazilian-funk` | Force Brazilian funk mode |
| `--genre` | Override: brazilian_funk, brazilian_phonk, retro_wave, synthwave, trance, house, lofi, jazz |
| `--deep-genre` | CLAP DL genre detection (default on; skipped if `--genre` given) |
| `--iterate N` | AI improvement iterations (default 20) |
| `--target-similarity` | Target for `--iterate` (default 0.85) |
| `--ollama` / `--ollama-model` | Use Ollama (default on) / model (default `midi-grep-strudel-mistral`) |
| `--ignore-gate-stop` | Keep iterating past the eval-gate floor toward `--target-similarity` (disables early-success stop) |
| `--codegen` | `orchestrated` (default; job-based, validated) or `single` (legacy one-shot ollama_codegen) |

Generative flags: `--mode granular|rave`, `--models`, `--github`, `--threshold`, `--epochs`, `--grain-ms`.

## 4. Python scripts (`scripts/python/`)

| Script | Role |
|--------|------|
| `separate.py` | Demucs stems (melodic/bass/drums/vocals); stem cache invalidates on change |
| `analyze.py` / `smart_analyze.py` | BPM/key with candidates / chord+section detection |
| `transcribe.py`, `cleanup.py` | Basic Pitch → MIDI, then quantization |
| `detect_drums.py` | Drum onset detection/classification |
| `detect_genre_dl.py` / `detect_genre_essentia.py` | CLAP / Essentia genre detection |
| `codegen_orchestrator.py` | **DEFAULT codegen** (`--codegen orchestrated`): job-based — structure/bass/lead/drums jobs, each JSON validated + retried, deterministic assembler guarantees 3-voice arrange()+setcps; per-section gains for build/drop dynamics; writes job_run.json |
| `job_runner.py` | Generic job DAG runner: JobSpec/JobResult, topo order, per-job validate→retry≤2 (error fed back)→logged fallback |
| `strudel_validation.py` | **Single source of truth** for valid sounds/banks/methods + corrections (tr808→RolandTR808) + `validate_code()`; used by all codegen paths |
| `ollama_codegen.py` | LEGACY single-shot codegen (`--codegen single`); genre sound RAG in `build_prompt()`; `enforce_three_voices()`; `fix_strudel_syntax()` |
| `ollama_agent.py` | Agentic LLM (iteration): per-track memory, genre RAG, `_validate_code()` (delegates to strudel_validation), `splice_voices()` |
| `ai_improver.py` | Iteration loop + ClickHouse learning; skips iteration on validation failure |
| `ai_code_generator.py` | Rule-based generator (legacy/fallback to Ollama) |
| `compare_audio.py` | Rendered-vs-original similarity (MAE freq balance — see §6); `--config` for tempo tolerance |
| `editable-pipeline.sh` (scripts/) | Spec 004 driver, stages 1–10 idempotent (`--force`, `--no-iteration-stems`, `--render-stems solo|demucs`; stage 10 = report.html, failure is fatal), `--mode both|sample-instrument|synth`, `--iters`, `--dur`, `--r2|--local`, `--genre` (logged override), BlackHole probe + idle guard; render preflight also runs `renderer.py browser` (a missing puppeteer Chromium stops the run before calibration, with the install command); stage 4/5 outputs are stamped with `calibration_memory.py code-version --stage pack|instruments` (`pack.code`, per-model `.code`) and rebuilt/retrained when the builder code changed — the calibrate hash includes those builders, so calibration reruns on the new pack/instruments; JSON summary on stdout |
| `build_instruments.py` | Granular model dirs (`pitched_map`, legacy per-grain medians fallback) + kit one-shots → `instruments/samples.json` (note-keyed dicts, kit arrays, absolute `_base`); re-measures every sample (keep ≤0.5 st / relabel / drop) → `verification.json` with per-instrument repitch coverage |
| `pitched_grains.py` | One grain per transcribed note (onset → note end, clipped at the next onset; P25 stub floor; P75-sustained preferred; a note with its own audible attack is extended to where the STEM stops sounding it — own decay or next attack, `ring_end`, trimmed where the pitch leaves the label by > 1 st, `pitch_stable_end`, kept only if it still verifies — so an 808 keeps its sub tail; attack moved to sample 0; per-pitch choice prefers a grain at or above that pitch's median loudness over ALL its grains (not the long ones only: Regime d#1 sat 8.4 dB under the stem); `rave/trainer.py` passes `StemRing`), label = pyin median of the stable part (window from fmin) with a harmonic-salience fallback for polyphonic stems and explicit octave rejection |
| `tempo_refine.py` | Phase-coherence period scan within ± one tempogram bin of the coarse librosa tempo (stamp refines on drums.wav → `bpm`, `bpm_coarse`, `bpm_method`, `bpm_confidence`) |
| `renderer.py` | `MIDIGREP_RENDERER` switch (default `offline`) shared by the Python tools; `browser` subcommand prints puppeteer's Chromium path, exit 1 with the install command when missing |
| `pipeline_helpers.py` | `slug`, `num-bars`, `next-version`, `promote` (vNNN + metadata), `stamp` (bpm/key/duration/genre provenance into the track metadata.json), `report` (stage 10: `--track-dir --version --seconds [--calib-workdir W] [--no-iteration-stems] [--render-stems solo|demucs] [--force]`; `render_{bass,drums,melodic}` come from `solo_stems.py` unless `demucs` -> `vNNN/{report.html, comparison.png, chart_*.png, render_*.mp3 (wav twins dropped after the per-stem comparison), render.mp3, embed/*.mp3 (128k twins of the original stems), stem_comparison.json, iterations.json, iterations/}`; `generate_report.py` embeds the mp3 twin whenever one exists (report ~42 MB instead of 227 MB), declared in `metadata.json`; the stamped `comparison.json` is never rewritten because `compare_audio.py --chart` overwrites `<chart dir>/comparison.json`, so charts are made in a temp dir) |
| `generate_dynamic_strudel.py` | Editable generator: bar arrays per voice, `--mode sample-instrument\|synth`, `cal-*` knobs (no vocal voice/knob — vocals are never generated, 2026-10-19); emits `// generation_mode:` header and self-validates with `strudel_validation` |
| `melodic_shape.py` | Lead + chords note shape from the melodic stem (`--melodic-shape stem`, default): retrigger only where the stem has an onset (chords follow the lead's onsets), hold (`c4@3`) to the next onset / stem silence (Otsu level) / bar end, sample loop points (`leadLoop`); a pitch change inside a hold is kept as a legato note (`leadLegato` / `chordsLegato`: same instrument entered at its loop start with a one-step tempo-derived fade-in, editable `legatoAttack`) only when the stem's chroma sounds the new pitch classes more than the held ones (`chroma_support`); `off` = the old 16th retrigger stream. The generator's lead pick per step is the LOUDEST transcribed note (Basic Pitch velocity, `loudest_pitches`), not the highest; chords exclude it. Sample bass notes with no stem attack go to an editable `bassLegato` array entered at the grain's loop start (synth mode and `--bass-shape off` unchanged). `missed_attacks`: a stem lead attack the transcription missed is written with the pitch the stem sounds there. Harmony (`generate_dynamic_strudel.harmony_notes`): a transcribed note under the velocity floor is still kept when the melodic stem's chroma sounds its pitch class while it lasts (`stem_sounds_note`, Otsu over the 12 class means; the overtone-of-a-louder-note rule still applies) |
| `bass_shape.py` | Bass note shape from the bass stem: attacks are claimed at the stem's log-RMS rise (not a backtracked onset), and a strong stem attack the transcription missed is written with the stem's f0/chroma pitch; loop points are whole periods of the label's f0 at smooth seams |
| `note_dynamics.py` | Per-note lead/chord level (sample-instrument, generator `--lead-dynamics stem`, default; `off` = flat): the melodic stem's RMS over each written note vs what its grain plays (grain RMS x voice gain x envelope), median-normalised and clamped at 3 robust sigma in the log domain, written as parallel `leadVel` / `leadLegatoVel` / `chordsVel` / `chordsLegatoVel` arrays applied with `.velocity(cat(...))` (superdough multiplies gain by velocity); recorded in `metadata.json` `lead_dynamics` |
| `drum_pitch.py` | Tuned 808: per-kick-hit `.speed()` from the pitch its stem hit's tail sounds, relative to the kick one-shot's own pitch; unreadable hits keep speed 1; generator `--drum-pitch off` disables |
| `bass_register.py` | Bass note register vs the stem f0: `resolve()` snaps candidates to the stem's octave; a candidate that is a non-octave harmonic of the local f0 (`harmonic_of`, harmonics derived from the pitch-class tolerance) is written as the fundamental `round(f0)` |
| `drum_oneshots.py` | Drum one-shots cut from the SAME hits that drive the pattern (`detect_drums_bands.detect`): start at the rising edge of the class's own band (1.5 ms fade-in, attack at sample 0), end at own decay (the hit's peak is searched before the next onset of any class; an undecayed hit ends at that onset) / next own-class retrigger / a foreign-class hit whose bleed is a robust 3-sigma outlier against the class's own median band profile; ranked by distance to the median profile of all decayed cuts, medoid fallback for an outlying pick; thresholds from the stem. The drums are quantised on the hits' measured beat phase (`generate_hybrid_strudel.grid_phase`, circular mean, used only when it lowers the error) and the drums stack carries one `.late()` |
| `solo_stems.py` | Stage-10 `render_{melodic,drums,bass}` straight from the renderer (no Demucs): `output.strudel` is split by the generator's channel labels (BASS / DRUMS / every other pitched label = melodic; an unlabelled channel is an error), each group rendered with the others muted by a trailing `.gain(0)` (muted channels stay so orbits/ducking survive), `render_vocals` = silence. `pipeline_helpers.py report --render-stems solo` (default) \| `demucs` (old path) |
| `bass_solo.py` (`solo`, `measure`) | Renders only the BASS channel; `measure` = per-band power of `bass.wav` (x master-gain^2) over the solo render's, an absolute level (not a mix share the kick also fills). `calibrate_dynamic.py --bass-solo JSON` sets the bass sample layer (`bass-mult`; full sqrt step bounded 0.5-2x) from it; sub-gain stays on mix shares; `auto-calibrate.sh` runs it every iteration, `AC_BSOLO=off` skips, failure falls back to mix shares |
| `melodic_solo.py` (`solo`, `measure`) | Same for LEAD+CHORDS vs `melodic.wav`: low_mid+mid power level and spectral centroid. `--melodic-solo JSON` sets `cal-lead` (sqrt step, 0.5-2x) and the lead low-pass (voices' own centroid ratio); sample-instrument mode only; `AC_MSOLO=off` skips. Generator `--lead-hpf 0` (default) = the lowest fundamental lead+chords play (`sample_lead_hpf`); synth mode starts at 300 and calibrates it |
| `build_sample_pack.py` | Stem → sample pack: drum one-shots (`drum_oneshots.py`), note-aligned pitch-verified multisamples for bass/melodic (`pitched_grains.py`), host-resolved `samples.json`; never vocals (strips old `*_vocal`/`vox*` entries) |
| `calibrate_dynamic.py` (+ `--env-correction-out/-in`, `--bpm`, `--bars`, `--mode`, `--bass-lpf/--bass-lpf-max/--bass-note-max-hz`, `--lead-hpf/--lead-note-min-hz`) | Global knob levers from `comparison.json` synth-only spectral-placement levers (`--mode synth`): `lead_hpf` (orig/rend low_mid-per-mid share ratio raises the lead high-pass; floor = lowest lead fundamental, ceiling = top of the low_mid band 500 Hz; run 2 showed it only moves low_mid 54->49% - the melodic excess is mostly the sung line, fixed at generation by `partial_register.py`, see below) has priority over `bass_lpf` (low_mid-per-bass ratio; floor 2x top bass fundamental, ceiling = analysis cutoff; bass-mult may not rise while it moves); dead bands x/÷1.33; inputs come from the generator summary JSON (`bass_lpf`/`bass_lpf_analysis`/`bass_note_max_hz`/`lead_hpf`/`lead_note_min_hz`); the lead env multiplier is cut-only on a lead_hpf step; `auto-calibrate.sh --start` takes `BM SG CL LLPF HG MG CV [BL [LH]]`, exits 70 if any iteration failed (BEST still printed). Synth vocal gain: the high_mid proxy may not RAISE `cal_vocal` while low_mid-per-mid is >=1.33x too heavy (gain cannot fix placement). `auto-calibrate.sh` picks BEST after the loop by smallest margin to the eval-gate floors (`scripts/python/gate_margin.py` -> `eval/gate.py` loader); if the gate is unreadable for ANY iteration all iterations are ranked by overall instead (warned). Generator `--lead-octave/--vocal-octave auto|0..2` (synth only): `partial_register.py` measures the original stem's dominant-partial register vs the transcribed fundamentals (cached in `sample_pack/register.json`), minus the palette sound's per-note SWEEP reference (shift k <= floor(original): the shifted fundamental may not exceed the original's dominant partial; within that bound k minimises |original - (ref at the SHIFTED notes + k)|; the summary JSON carries `*_octave_decision` with bound and candidates) from `data/partial_reference.json` (written by `probe_sound_register.py --sound <s>`: one BlackHole render of a chromatic c2..c6 sweep, no filters; empty table = warn + no shift), and transposes the DATA up 0-2 octaves. Hats: back off multiplicatively when the drums stem's `high` share is >2x the original's (a full-mix proxy does this only on a step where lead-lpf did not move) and keep the drums path shut when full-mix `high` is already >1.33x; old path needs `r_cent > 1.15` and lead-lpf >= 7000; new drums-as-source path also needs `r_cent > 1.15`, plus lead-lpf >= 4 kHz (high_mid band top, from `compare_audio.FREQ_BANDS`) and the render's high+high_mid share under half the original's, and then lead-lpf is held that step) PLUS a per-bar env-correction JSON `{window_s,bpm,bars,clamp:[lo,hi],voices:{bass,lead,master}}` derived from `section_windows` (fix #10). `--bpm/--bars` MUST be the generator's grid (auto-calibrate passes them); a previous curve with another bar count is resampled onto the new grid (stderr warning). The generator clamps the composed voice×master multiplier to the file's `clamp`; `pipeline_helpers.py promote --env-correction` persists the file as `vNNN/env_correction.json` (+ `metadata.env_correction`). The synth stage does NOT reuse the sample-instrument-measured correction (unmeasured cross-mode transfer). |
| `render_jobs.py` (`jobs --independent N`) | How many offline renders may run at once: `min(N, cpus // RENDER_CORES, (available memory - HEADROOM_MB) // RENDER_RSS_MB)`, at least 1 (macOS `vm_stat` free+inactive+speculative+purgeable, Linux MemAvailable; unreadable machine = 1). `MIDIGREP_RENDER_JOBS=<n>` overrides (capped at N; invalid = exit 64), `MIDIGREP_RENDER_RSS_MB` / `MIDIGREP_RENDER_CORES` replace the measured per-render footprint. Used by `auto-calibrate.sh` (mix + bass solo + melodic solo of an iteration run concurrently, the mix compare overlaps the solos, all child trees reaped on failure/SIGINT/SIGTERM, `MIDIGREP_RENDERER=blackhole` forces 1) and `pipeline_helpers.solo_render_stems` (stage 10) |
| `mix_dynamics.py` (`next-master`, `choose`, `report`, `shares`) | Loudness stage run by `auto-calibrate.sh` after BEST (skip with `--no-mix-dynamics`). `compare_audio` rms-normalizes both signals, so the score never sees level: raw renders were 6-13 dB under the mastered instrumental (crest 17-18 dB vs ~10). One measured lever, the generator `--master-gain`: `new = old * 10^((ref_rms - render_rms)/20)`, up to 3 render rounds (full-scale clipping makes gain->RMS sub-linear). Crest is verified, not a lever (RMS +/-1 dB, crest +/-1.5 dB); the clipped share (`clip_frac`) is printed beside the reference's share within 3 dB of its peak (`plateau_frac`). `choose` keeps the highest-overall round whose overall AND section-aware stay within `calibration_noise` of the unmixed BEST, else the unmixed BEST stays; the final gain is written to `best.master` (best.params keeps the loop's knobs - it seeds the next mode). Why not per-voice dynamics (measured 2026-10-20): superdough's orbit has no master bus; `.compressor` is per hap with a >=1 ms attack (a bass limited to -0.5 dBFS still peaked at +6.6) and layers/voices add in phase; a tanh saturator per layer with ceilings summing to the reference peak needed master +17 dB and still ended at crest 16.6. `shares` = per-voice energy share of the render (solo renders) vs the original stems, diagnostic only: applying it as gains scored worse/inconsistent (Demucs bleed). `renderer`'s `sampleFailures` no longer treats "...in 404ms" as an HTTP 404. |
| `editability_check.py` | Replay/editability detector (spec 003 §2.2-A rules R1–R6): `check_editability(code)` → `EditabilityResult`, CLI exit 0/1/2, `--json`; `strudel_validation.validate_code` also rejects `.loopAt(` and `<stem>full`/`<stem>loop` sounds |
| `spectrogram_analyzer.py` | Mel-spectrogram deep analysis → actionable dB-diff insights for prompts |
| `sound_selector.py` | Catalog: 67 drum machines, 128 GM instruments, 17 genre palettes; `retrieve_genre_context(genre)` RAG (~40 tokens) |
| `synth_profiles.py` | Per-genre synth character (`apply_genre_profile`): nudges bass gain / sub_octave_gain / master.hpf / drums transient on top of analysis-derived `synth_config.json`. Also `get_sidechain_depth(genre)` + `sidechain_instruction(genre)` (kick-ducks-bass). Applied via `analyze_synth_params.py --genre` (genre passed from Go). |
| `thin_patterns.py` | Pattern-density control to match onset density |
| `generate_report.py` | Self-contained HTML report (DAW player, isolated stem groups, shimmer loading) |
| `audio_to_strudel_params.py` | AI effect-parameter suggestion from spectral/dynamic analysis |
| `rave/` | RAVE generative pipeline (cli, pipeline, trainer, repository, timbre_embeddings) |

## 5. Node/TypeScript renderers (`scripts/node/src/`)

- `render-strudel-offline.ts` — **default** (2026-10-19). @strudel/web 1.3.0 (core 1.2.6, webaudio 1.3.0, superdough 1.3.0) + @strudel/soundfonts 1.2.6, headless Chromium, chunked ~20 s / ≤1200-onset whole-cycle windows in fresh pages, each with a discarded pre-roll of the previous tail-length of haps (cut/duck/tails cross boundaries) and absolute hap cycles, polyphony 4096, retries crashed pages ×3, loud failures; output written atomically only after all checks pass. A network failure (`net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED`, a page navigation timeout, etc., `offline-helpers.isNetworkFailure`) is waited out with backoff 5/10/20/40/60 s up to `MIDIGREP_RENDER_NET_WAIT_S` (default 1800) instead of failing the run. Callers treat a non-zero exit as failure. `MIDIGREP_RENDERER` selects (`scripts/python/renderer.py`).
- `record-strudel-blackhole.ts` — cross-check only (raw capture drops ~12% samples; the asetrate relabel lowers pitch ~2.3–2.7 st; rate now from steady-state file growth, `capture-rate.ts`). Records real Strudel from `strudel.dygy.app/embed`
  via BlackHole + ffmpeg, browser hidden offscreen. ~100% accurate. Key gotchas: insert code via
  CodeMirror `cmView.view.dispatch` (not textContent); call `setSinkId()` on AudioContext AFTER
  clicking play; `--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required`; default (not incognito) context;
  `headless:false`. Leading-silence fix: ffmpeg `silenceremove=start_periods=1:...`.
- `render-strudel-node.ts` — REMOVED (Jun 2026; an emulation, unlike the offline renderer which IS Strudel).
  Build: `cd scripts/node && npm install && npm run build` (puppeteer + tsc are required).
- Recorder capture (Oct 2026): RAW device stream + one uniform speed correction from the samples/
  wall-clock ratio (default); `MIDIGREP_CAPTURE=wallclock` = the Jun 2026 wall-clock+async path, which
  jitters beat timing (±35 ms gaps) and made renders read ~123 BPM.

Node voice-gain defaults (Brazilian funk tuned): bass {gain 0.6, lpf 400, hpf 30, sub_octave 0.5},
mid {0.5, lpf 5k, hpf 200}, high {0.4, lpf 8k, hpf 400}, drums {0.7, transient_boost 0.4}, 30Hz master HPF.
808 kicks: pitch env to 35Hz, no HPF (let sub through). Soft saturation: `tanh(x*3.0)`.

## 6. Similarity calculation (compare_audio.py)

Uses **MAE** (mean absolute error) on frequency bands, NOT cosine — cosine hid 20%+ band errors
(showed 95% when sub_bass was −25% off). Penalty if any band >15% off. Weights:
Frequency Balance **40%**, MFCC 20%, Energy 15%, Brightness 15%, Tempo 5%, Chroma 5%.
Tracks `band_differences`, `worst_band_diff`. Current: Electro Swing ~67%, Russian Hip-Hop ~59%
(those and every pre-2026-10-18 number are on this time-averaged scale, now `static_similarity`).

**Rescale (2026-10-18, fix `similarity-blind-time-average`).** The time-averaged score could not tell the
song apart (VAGABUNDO original vs our v004 render 0.932, vs a DIFFERENT song 0.876, vs its drums stem 0.775).
`overall_similarity = 0.5 × static_similarity + 0.5 × temporal_similarity`. Temporal: the render is aligned
to the original by the lag maximising onset-envelope cross-correlation, bounded by one bar at the original's
tempo (`temporal.lag_seconds`); then on the aligned signals `chroma_corr` (per-frame Pearson over 12
chroma_cqt bins, non-silent frames), `mel_corr` (same on 64-band log-mel), `onset_f1` (greedy one-to-one
onset matching ±50 ms, MIREX convention, no mir_eval dep), `envelope_corr` (frame RMS Pearson); mean of the
four clamped to [0,1]. Section windows carry `static`, `temporal` and the four components, `win` = 50/50.
Alignment (2026-10-19): true local maxima of the onset-xcorr within ±1 bar (bar = measured 3 or 4 beats at the track tempo) are candidates; the onset best stays unless a tied candidate (deficit < 1 standard error block-wise, or a whole number of bars away) is separated by the beat-block chroma trajectory by > 1 standard error of its own; unscorable scores are null; `temporal.lag_candidates` records them (onset_score, harmony_score, onset_tied, chosen, decided_by). `--control <path>` scores another same-genre original against the same original (no nested control, no
synth_config) → `comparison.chance {path, overall, section_aware, temporal}` + `margin_over_chance`.
`eval/gate.py` fails below `min_margin_over_chance` (0.02, thresholds.yaml); genre-wide floors (old scale)
are compared with `static_similarity` (section-aware: mean window `static`). `gate_margin.py` adds the chance
margin. `pipeline_helpers.py control --genre G --exclude-key K` picks the control from
`eval/datasets/reference_tracks.yaml`; driver stage 8 passes it. Re-measured on the existing renders:
Regime v026 0.6967/0.6736 (+0.120), v027 synth 0.5589/0.5525 (−0.018, FAIL), VAGABUNDO v004 0.6626/0.6223
(+0.086), v007 synth 0.6627/0.5860 (+0.086); mode floors sample-instrument 0.64/0.60, synth 0.54/0.53.
2026-10-19 re-baseline (offline renderer, refined tempo, note-aligned verified instruments, no vocals,
scored vs instrumental.wav): sample-instrument VAGABUNDO v013 0.7170/0.7073, Regime v031 0.7794/0.7744 → floors 0.70/0.69; synth VAGABUNDO v014 0.7240/0.7007, Regime v032 0.7479/0.7361 → floors 0.70/0.68; margins +0.142 to +0.204 (v013 +0.142, v014 +0.149, v031 +0.204, v032 +0.173).
Target: 80%+ across genres via AI learning, not hardcoding.
Tempo estimate (Oct 2026): `estimate_tempo()` keeps the full-band `beat_track` read and adds a low-band (30-200 Hz STFT-flux) `librosa.feature.tempo` candidate (original's BPM only as `start_bpm`); the candidate with stronger onset-envelope autocorrelation support wins. Both candidates + `tempo_method` are written to `comparison.json` (`tempo_candidates`, `tempo_method`); weights unchanged.

## 7. Caching & output (`.cache/stems/{key}/`)

Keyed by URL or file hash. Stems: melodic/drums/bass/vocals.wav + `.version`. Per output version
`v001/`: output.strudel, metadata.json, render.wav, per-iteration render/stem files, iterations.json,
comparison.json, charts, ai_params.json, synth_config.json, report.html.

## 8. ClickHouse learning

- `midi_grep.runs` — every render attempt (track_hash, version, similarity_*, strudel_code, parameters, genre, bpm, key_type).
- `midi_grep.knowledge` — learned param deltas (parameter_name, old/new, similarity_improvement, confidence, context).
Local: `./bin/clickhouse local --path .clickhouse/db --query "..."`. Do NOT clear — it's learning data.

## 9. LLM setup (Ollama)

`brew install ollama` → `ollama serve` → `ollama pull mistral-small` → `ollama create midi-grep-strudel-mistral -f Modelfile.mistral`.
Default model is **`midi-grep-strudel-mistral`** (mistral-small base + Modelfile system prompt that enforces 3-voice
`arrange()` structure and sound-naming rules — chosen as the middle ground that fits 24GB RAM; the 70B `midi-grep-strudel`
needs ~48GB, and plain `llama3.1:8b` hallucinates). Validation rejects invalid methods (`.peak(`, `.volume(`, `.eq(`, …)
and hallucinated sound names (`gm_pad_N_*` → `gm_pad_*`, `gm_electric_piano_1` → `gm_epiano1`, etc.).
Genre-aware sound RAG injects ~15 relevant sounds (~40 tokens) instead of the full 800-token catalog.

## 10. Go packages (`internal/`)

`audio/` (input, stems, youtube), `analysis/` (BPM/key), `midi/` (transcribe, cleanup), `pipeline/`
(orchestrator — calls Python AI), `server/` (Chi + HTMX + jobs + SSE), `exec/` (Python subprocess
runner; auto-detects `scripts/python/.venv`; set `PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1`), `cache/`, `drums/`,
`report/` (Go HTML report generator), `generative/` (RAVE Go wrapper).

Genre auto-detection in orchestrator.go: `shouldUseBrazilianFunkMode()`,
`shouldUseBrazilianPhonkMode()`, `shouldUseRetroWaveMode()`; `--genre` bypasses detection.

## 11. Agent workflow & orchestration

- `.awos/` — AWOS commands (product, roadmap, spec, tech, tasks, implement, architecture, qa,
  verify) + templates; `subagents/` domain experts (golang, python, audio-dsp, ml-audio, strudel,
  llm, music-theory, react, kotlin).
- `.claude/skills/` — skill-creator, self-review, prompt-engineering, sisyphus-plan, docs-that-work,
  modern-python-development, pytest-best-practices, python-testing-patterns, typescript-development, wt.
- `.sisyphus/` — durable plan + evidence orchestration (see `.claude/skills/sisyphus-plan/`).
- `eval/` — `thresholds.yaml` similarity gate (per-genre floors) + `gate.py` + reference-track
  datasets; gate runs in pytest AND is wired into the `--iterate` loop (`ai_improver.py`): renders
  below the genre floor are auto-rejected once the floor has been cleared, the loop early-success
  stops as soon as the floor is cleared, and the run is reported PASSED/FAILED with a `gate` block
  in `iterations.json`.

## 12. Testing

`go test ./...`; `cd scripts/python && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -v`;
eval gate: `pytest scripts/python/tests/test_similarity_gate.py`.
